dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped high-contrast rings with jagged, high-frequency perimeter boundaries. Prominent annuli in the center-right show a sharp gradient transition from low-intensity dark centers to high-intensity light-colored edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily located along the upper dorsal ridge and the far-left lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the central region form an obtuse scalene triangle. A series of high-intensity blobs on the anterior-left flank form a vertically-oriented, irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: Complex, interconnected chain-like pattern of overlapping annuli on the posterior-left flank, creating a nested texture topology.
